2609.04135.title: The Natural Language Interaction Protocol and Standard for AI Agents
2609.04135.paper_summary: AI agents are increasingly being developed and deployed across organizations using heterogeneous agent-development frameworks, AI models, tool interfaces, protocols, and execution environments. To realize their potential social and business impact, these agents must be able to interoperate through a common communication protocol. The Natural Language Interaction Protocol (NLIP), developed by researchers and practitioners across companies and universities and standardized by Ecma International, addresses this need by defining a standards-based application-layer protocol for AI-agent interaction. NLIP provides a lightweight semantic message envelope that can be carried over existing transports such as HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, and AMQP, while allowing NLIP-aware agents and gateways to adapt between clients, agents, local context stores, ontologies, tools, enterprise services, and heterogeneous underlying protocols. This paper presents the motivation and design rationale of NLIP, its message model and transport bindings, security-by-design considerations, reference implementation, representative applications, adoption signals, and relationship to emerging agent protocols such as MCP and A2A.
2609.04135.paper_summary_zh: AI代理正在各組織中越來越多地開發和部署，使用異構的代理開發框架、AI模型、工具介面、協議和執行環境。<lb/>為了實現其潛在的社會和商業影響，這些代理必須能夠通過通用通信協議進行互操作。<lb/>自然語言互動協議（NLIP）由來自公司和大學的研究人員和實踐者開發，並由Ecma International標準化，滿足了這一需求，通過定義基於標準的應用層協議來實現AI代理之間的互動。<lb/>NLIP提供了一個輕量級的語義消息封裝，可以通過現有的傳輸協議如HTTP/HTTPS、WebSocket和AMQP進行傳輸，同時允許NLIP感知的代理和網關在客戶端、代理、本地上下文存儲、本體、工具、企業服務和異構底層協議之間進行適應。<lb/>本文介紹了NLIP的動機和設計原則、其消息模型和傳輸綁定、安全設計考量、參考實現、代表性應用、採用信號以及與新興代理協議如MCP和A2A的關係。
